# Price Check (2024 DMG and PHB)

> I checked these with a web search on 2026-11-13. I didn't have the books, so these are cross-checked against online reference copies. Anything marked **UNVERIFIED** should be confirmed against the 2024 *Player's Handbook* or *Dungeon Master's Guide* if you have them. The house rule is that **all coin counts as gold**, so prices under 1 gp get bundled and rounded.

## Magic items by rarity (2024 DMG)

| Rarity | Price | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Common | 100 gp | Matches the world file. Confirmed by several community sources quoting the 2024 DMG. |
| Uncommon | 400 gp | Confirmed the same way |
| Rare | 4,000 gp | Confirmed the same way |
| Very Rare | 40,000 gp | Confirmed the same way |
| Legendary | 200,000 gp | Confirmed the same way |
| Consumables (potions, scrolls) | half the rarity price | Widely cited for the 2024 DMG. **Mostly confirmed.** I couldn't read the exact sentence in the book. |
| Magic weapons and armor | rarity price + base item price | Confirmed by a D&D Beyond forum quote of the 2024 rules |

**Verdict:** the world file's table (`world/06`) is correct. The only caveat is that it came from secondhand sources quoting the book, not from the book itself.

## Adventuring gear (2024 PHB)

| Item | Price | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Potion of Healing | 50 gp | **Confirmed** (2024 gear list). The 2024 rules also make drinking it a bonus action, which matches our house rule. |
| Grappling Hook | 2 gp | **Confirmed** (2024 list) |
| Clothes, Fine | 15 gp | **Confirmed** (2024 list) |
| Mirror (steel) | 5 gp | **Confirmed** (2024-labeled list) |
| Manacles | 2 gp | **Confirmed** price. The weight is listed as 6 lb in 2024, versus 2 lb in older editions. |
| Caltrops (bag of 20) | 1 gp | **UNVERIFIED for 2024.** 1 gp is the 2014 price. |
| Piton | 5 cp each | **UNVERIFIED for 2024.** 2014 price. In 2024, pitons may come as part of a Climber's Kit rather than singly. |
| Chalk (1 piece) | 1 cp | **UNVERIFIED for 2024.** 2014 price. |

**Ash's shopping total:**

| Item | Price |
|---|---|
| Manacles | 2 |
| Grappling hook | 2 |
| Fine clothes | 15 |
| Caltrops | 1 |
| Steel mirror | 5 |
| Chalk and 10 pitons | under 1 gp, rounded to 1 |
| **Total** | **26 gp** |

36 − 26 = **10 gp left**. That matches `build/decisions.md`, so **no change was needed.**

## Find Familiar (2024), checked because of Bart's house rule
- **Confirmed:** the component is burning incense worth 10+ gp, which the spell consumes. Casting it while you already have a familiar makes the familiar take a new eligible form. That's how Bart's normal day-form change works.
- **UNVERIFIED:** the exact 2024 list of familiar forms. The 2014 list is bat, cat, crab, frog, hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, quipper, rat, raven, sea horse, spider and weasel. Online sources say the 2024 list is based on the CR 0 beasts in the Monster Manual. Owl, spider and rat are on every version.

### Campaign treasure sum (all chapters, typical play)
| Act | Coin (about) | Permanent magic items |
|---|---|---|
| I (Ch1–6, L1→7) | 650–1,000 gp | 8 (1 Common, 7 Uncommon) + 10 consumables |
| II (Ch7–13, L7→14) | 14,000–17,000 gp | 16 (2 Common, 5 Uncommon, 9 Rare) |
| III (Ch14–20, L14→20) | 33,000–42,000 gp | about 14 (about 7 Very Rare, 5–6 Rare, 1 Uncommon), Ash's +3 weapon in Ch16 |
| **Campaign** | **about 48,000–60,000 gp** | **about 38**, plus Row gifts and side-activity prizes |

- **Not checked against the 2024 DMG's treasure guidance** (the book wasn't available to verify; the step-6A price check covered rarity prices only). Judgment call: coin is modest for level 20 (a single Very Rare item costs 40,000 gp, so the party can't buy them; they find them), and item count is in a normal range for a 38-session campaign. **No trims made.** If play runs rich, trim side-activity purses first, then the second Very Rare item in Ch16 (per CHG-A3-13).
- Glimmer-cored items (every Row gift; Act I's Wand of the War Mage +1; Act II's Glimmer-lance, Lantern-Glaive, Wand of the War Mage +2) die in Ending 1. Track them in the Campaign Bible.
